<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אדר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917669_theRebbe_390" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_93_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917669_theRebbe_390__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that in the month of Nissan, the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof is manifest, and therefore no intercalation of the year is needed.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is “This month is for you the head of months,”</t>
    <t s="2">that in the month of Nissan is the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="3">And this is that when Rosh Chodesh Nissan arrives, we do not intercalate the year,</t>
    <t s="4">for the aspect of “year” is in the light that relates to the worlds,</t>
    <t s="5">and since the drawing down of this light is through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin,</t>
    <t s="6">we intercalate the year as needed so that the elevation of Mayin Nukvin will be in its proper manner,</t>
    <t s="7">therefore, when Rosh Chodesh Nissan arrives,</t>
    <t s="8">[being] the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof that is above arousal from below,</t>
    <t s="9">we do not intercalate the year,</t>
    <t s="10">as is explained at length in the maamar [note 36].</t>
    <t s="11">And this is also that the month of Nissan is the month of redemption,</t>
    <t s="12">for in Nissan they were redeemed and in Nissan they are destined to be redeemed [note 37],</t>
    <t s="13">for the concept of redemption is that then “your Teacher will no longer be hidden” [note 38],</t>
    <t s="14">the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof without any garment [note 39].</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section expresses the wish that all this be fulfilled speedily in the month of Nissan of this very year, with joy and feasting.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">May it be His will that all this be speedily, in our very own days,</t>
    <t s="1">in the month of Nissan of this very year,</t>
    <t s="2">and we will eat there from the offerings and from the Paschal sacrifices [note 40],</t>
    <t s="3">amidst joy and a good heart.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
